home.tevanQuote: Knowing a place is different from simply knowing the way through it.
home.tevanBody: My name is Tesema "Tevan" Mulualem. I built Gonder Simien Tours around a simple idea: help people experience the place I know—not just visit it. That means honest routes, real preparation and space for the moments no itinerary can schedule.

home.proofTitle: If we say it, we should show it.
home.proofPreparedBody: Guides, scouts, cooks, drivers, mule handlers, food and camp equipment coordinated before you reach the trail.
home.proofGuidanceBody: Advice shaped around your time, ability and interests—not an itinerary pushed onto every traveler.
home.proofRespectBody: Altitude, weather and wildlife are treated honestly. The route can flex when real conditions require judgment.
home.trailLead: Good planning is honest about what is known, what changes, and what still needs checking. Route decisions account for walking comfort, altitude, weather and current local conditions.
home.noInvented: No invented kilometre or elevation figures. Final route confirmed for current conditions.

about.title: The story starts here.
about.lead: “I want people to experience the place I know—not just visit it.”
about.heroAlt: Tesema ‘Tevan’ Mulualem standing in the Simien Mountains
about.whoBody: Tesema “Tevan” Mulualem is the founder and lead guide of {name}. The operating company is {operator}.
about.whereBody: The office is on {address}. We work in Gondar and Simien Mountains National Park, and we can discuss northern extensions when they fit your time.
about.howBody: Planning starts with a conversation—not a fixed package. Share your time and questions; a written proposal confirms the journey.
story: There is a road out of Gondar that I never get tired of taking. The city slowly disappears behind you. Houses become fewer, the landscape opens, the air changes and the road climbs. Then the Simien Mountains begin to appear. Every time I see them, I remember why I chose this work.
My name is Tesema ‘Tevan’ Mulualem. I am a local guide from Gondar, Ethiopia, and I created Gonder Simien Tours around the place I know as home.

Before the mountains were a destination on an itinerary, they were simply part of life. I learned how a familiar trail changes with the season, how clouds transform a valley in minutes, and how wildlife follows its own timetable. Knowing a place is different from simply knowing the way through it.
guiding: A traveler stops to watch a gelada and asks another question. Someone notices the farming terraces or wonders why a village was built where it is. Someone tries Ethiopian coffee for the first time. Someone reaches a viewpoint and goes quiet.
Guiding made me notice things I once took for granted. I realized that my job was to help people understand where they were, rather than simply point to the trail.

That is why I wanted to build a personal kind of travel. A couple looking for a quiet mountain experience, a photographer waiting for the light and a strong hiker preparing for Ras Dashen need different journeys. The first step is listening.
about.approachTag: The kind of travel I believe in
about.unexpectedBody: A quiet trail, a conversation on the road, a mountain appearing through cloud or a coffee when nobody is in a hurry. Sometimes the moment you remember most was never on the itinerary.
about.honestBody: If a trek is too ambitious, I will say so. If it needs more time, we discuss it. If weather or local conditions change the plan, we adapt. Wildlife sightings and summit success are never promises.
about.respectBody: Slow down enough to notice. Respect wildlife, communities, people’s privacy and the landscape. The Simien Mountains are a place where people live, as well as a place travelers come to discover.
about.credentialSource: Credentials and licensing are published on the <site>official operating company site</site>.
about.localTitle: The people are part of the journey.
about.localLead: You may see one guide, but a much bigger team often stands behind the trek: scouts, cooks, drivers, mule handlers, accommodation providers, suppliers and community hosts. They are part of the experience.
about.localBody: A successful journey depends on people working together. Tevan Local is our commitment to keep more value close to the people who make the journey possible, and to share evidence as that work grows.
equipment: Before you arrive, routes are planned, transport is organized, food is prepared and the mountain team is coordinated. Weather and equipment need attention long before the first walking day.

A tent matters when the wind moves through camp. A sleeping system matters when the temperature drops. Cooking equipment matters when dinner is being prepared after a long day on the trail. We prepare, check, clean, maintain and organize the gear before it becomes part of your journey.
Your final quotation explains the camping and sleeping equipment included. Tell us your comfort needs and ask about anything you plan to bring or hire.
about.noteQuote: “I have walked these mountains many times. But guiding has taught me that you never really see a place the same way twice. A traveler asks a question. Someone notices something you’ve walked past a hundred times. The light reaches the valley differently. Suddenly, you are seeing your own home through someone else’s eyes.”
about.noteClose: I want to share a place that means something to me. I hope that when you leave, the Simien means something to you too.
about.noteSignoff: Tesema “Tevan” · Founder & local guide · Gondar, Ethiopia

dayTrip.name: Simien Mountains Day Trip / Simien in a Day
overview: A one-day introduction to Simien Mountains National Park from Gondar. Travel north via Debark for park arrangements, then short mountain walks, escarpment viewpoints and time in known Gelada habitat. Designed for travellers with limited time who still want to leave the vehicle and spend time in the highlands. Walking difficulty is adjusted to the group.
highlights: One-day taste of Simien from Gondar
Time for Gelada observation if a troop is found (not guaranteed)
Short guided walks adjusted to the group

segments.label: Morning
segments.body: Hotel pickup in Gondar (typically around 06:30); briefing with your guide

segments.label: Gondar → Debark
segments.body: Highland road with farming, villages and geography commentary (~100 km; often up to around two hours)

segments.label: Debark → park
segments.body: Park arrangements; continue into Simien Mountains National Park as escarpments open

segments.label: Gelada / walk
segments.body: Observe if a troop is found; short Simien walk; possible viewpoints around Sankaber and the western escarpment

segments.label: Afternoon
segments.body: Further wildlife and landscape time as conditions allow (Gelada, Walia ibex, highland birds, giant lobelia — none guaranteed)

segments.label: Return
segments.body: Via Debark to Gondar by evening

included: Private transportation from Gondar to Simien and return; hotel pickup and drop-off in Gondar
Professional English-speaking local guide; driver and fuel
Simien National Park entrance fee / park arrangements; required park scout/ranger
Lunch; drinking water according to the day’s arrangement; tea/coffee where included in the itinerary
Short guided walks according to the agreed programme; wildlife and landscape interpretation
excluded: International and domestic flights; visa/eVisa; travel insurance
Personal trekking equipment; personal snacks and drinks; alcohol; tips; personal purchases
Optional activities; any service not specifically listed in the quotation

royal-gondar.title: Royal Gondar experience
royal-gondar.body: Explore Fasil Ghebbi and the royal city with the stories of its emperors, architecture and court life. Connect the historic compound to the Gondar around it.
royal-gondar.fit: First visits, history lovers and architectural photography

local-gondar.title: Gondar through local eyes
local-gondar.body: Walk through neighbourhoods, visit small businesses and share coffee and conversation. Your guide introduces the everyday city they live in.
local-gondar.fit: Travelers who value conversation and an unhurried pace

food-coffee.title: Food & coffee experience
food-coffee.body: Follow coffee roasting, local ingredients and the stories behind injera, spices and shared meals. Coffee preparation, food markets and traditional dishes can shape the day.
food-coffee.fit: Curious eaters and coffee lovers; tell us your dietary needs

gondar-photo.title: Gondar photography walk
gondar-photo.body: Look for morning light on stone walls, opening shops and quieter streets. There is time for photographs and conversations, with permission before photographing people.
gondar-photo.fit: Phone photographers, enthusiasts and visual storytellers

history-culture.title: History & culture tour
history-culture.body: Connect churches, religious traditions, architecture, trade, art and music with modern Ethiopian life. The route follows the stories that interest you most.
history-culture.fit: Travelers who want a deeper historical and cultural context

market-life.title: Market & local life
market-life.body: Explore market areas when conditions and trading days suit. Learn about local products, farming connections and how goods move between Gondar and the highlands.
market-life.fit: Visitors interested in food, trade and everyday city life

kosoye.title: Gondar & Kosoye highlands
kosoye.body: Travel from the city into countryside, farmland and rural walking routes. Village visits, local food, coffee and family conversations are arranged respectfully with hosts.
kosoye.fit: Walkers and travelers interested in the countryside

gondar-heritage-simien.fit: Travelers who want culture and mountains in one journey
